string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_140_highlights
string-array.item: Noise generator in Focus, and a new Sleep space.
Screensaver when charging in landscape, made for OLED screens.
Six new widgets, a lock-screen player and Quick Settings tiles for Focus, Lofi and Noise.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_140_improvements
string-array.item: Shake and face-down gestures work with the screen off.
Shuffle follows the Phone / Cloud filter and covers the whole library.
More reliable widgets; drag along the bottom bar to switch tabs.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_130_highlights
string-array.item: Spaces on Home: Lofi (generator, radio, ambience), Focus, Listening garden, Party queue, Taste match and Cover studio.
Living artwork that breathes with the song, and double-tap to like.
Artist story on every artist page.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_130_improvements
string-array.item: Swipe the mini player for next and previous; swipe between pages; slimmer bottom bar.
Stronger haptics and optional shake and face-down gestures.
Crash reports and safe mode.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_120_highlights
string-array.item: New Home: continue listening, Made for you mixes, recently added and your top artists.
Smart features (experimental): on-device mood and genre tags, mixes, song radio and insights.
Weekly and monthly recaps you can share.
Refined haptics across the app.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_120_improvements
string-array.item: Choose the music folders to include.
Update alerts from GitHub, smart shuffle and Library health with batch autofill.
Smaller now-playing layout with a sleep timer and song menu.
Every screen and widget redesigned in Yuyu.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_110_highlights
string-array.item: A new look across the whole app: clean white and ink surfaces, Bricolage Grotesque headlines and Figtree text.
The player takes its accent from the album art: seek bar, play button and background follow every song.
New Home with Your mix, Recently played and this week\'s listening at a glance.
Stats now has its own tab in the bottom bar.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_110_improvements
string-array.item: Song rows, the mini player, the bottom bar and Settings redesigned around the new components.
A new About page.

string-array.name: nobody_listens_changelog_100_highlights
string-array.item: Edit tags straight into your MP3, FLAC and M4A files, including album artist, year and composer.
Autofill tags from MusicBrainz and the Cover Art Archive — free, no account and no key.
Listening stats with a 30-second play rule: week, month, year, lifetime and custom ranges.
